name: Tibrin
description: Tibrin was an aquatic planet covered in phosphorescent seas with towering coral reefs as tall as the sky. It was located in the Tibrin system, a trinary star system on the edge of the Hadar sector in the Mid Rim. It was the homeworld of the Ishi Tib species.
